comp-bio.headline: Bioinformatics · Cancer Genomics
comp-bio.tagline: Computational scientist and bioinformatician (M.Sc. Molecular Biotechnology) with hands-on NGS workflows for HLA typing and predicted splice-derived MHC-I neoepitope candidates, plus production Python/cloud data engineering. Maintains a public Snakemake pipeline from RNA-Seq to ranked neoepitope candidates. Eleven peer-reviewed publications from a separate imaging, DNA-repair, chromatin, and radiation-biology research track. Carried out doctoral research at FZ Jülich (doctorate not awarded).
comp-bio.lead_paragraph: Engineered in-silico pipelines for HLA typing and neoantigen candidate discovery from real-patient NGS and RNA-Seq data at NCT and SNU (unpublished computational project work), later packaged as reproducible Snakemake workflows. A parallel experimental-biophysics line at DKFZ, FZ Jülich, and KIP produced 11 peer-reviewed research publications — first- and shared-first author — in super-resolution microscopy of DNA-damage repair and chromatin, not genomics.
comp-bio.second_paragraph: Equally at home in production: migrated 1,000+ analytical processes to Google Cloud, built reproducible data pipelines, and mentored 100+ specialists in Python, SQL & ML — while securing third-party funding and supervising 10+ students.

bullets.en: Bioinformatics: Rebuilt the 2015 SNU computational prototype in Snakemake to predict splice neoepitope candidates.
bullets.de: Bioinformatik: SNU-Prototyp von 2015 in Snakemake für vorhergesagte Splice-Neoepitop-Kandidaten neu aufgebaut.
